change: Removed 'Upper Traps' from primary mid back group. For a seated row with V-bar pulling to the lower abdomen, scapular retraction is driven by Rhomboids and Lower Traps (retraction + depression). Upper Traps are engaged in upward scapular rotation/elevation — not a meaningful prime mover in this horizontal pull pattern. Retained Rhomboids + Lower Traps as the correct mid back primaries. All secondary muscles unchanged.

Removed 'Shin' (Fibularis) from secondary. EMG and biomechanics research confirms the seated calf raise is a near-isolation of the soleus (with minimal gastrocnemius due to knee flexion active insufficiency). The peroneal/fibularis muscles provide minor ankle eversion stabilization but do not meaningfully assist plantar flexion in a machine-guided calf raise — removing to avoid inflation. Gastrocnemius secondary retained as minimal but real.

Removed 'Shin' (Fibularis) from secondary for the same reason as seated_calf_machine: seated knee-bent position makes this a soleus-dominant isolation; fibularis is not a meaningful stabilizer in a seated machine-like dumbbell-on-knee calf raise. Gastrocnemius secondary retained.

No change. Primary Calves (gastrocnemius + soleus) and secondary Hamstrings are correct: with leg extended the gastrocnemius (bi-articular) and soleus are fully stretched, and the hamstrings are passively lengthened in the seated forward reach position.

No change. Primary glutes (Gluteus Maximus + Gluteus Medius) are correct for this figure-4 cross-leg stretch. Piriformis is also stretched but has no allowed mapping entry and is correctly omitted. Lower Back (Erector Spinae) secondary is retained as the forward lean in this stretch places mild passive stretch on the lumbar erectors. Gluteus Minimus is also stretched but has no separate allowed entry (covered under the Gluteus Medius grouping is acceptable).
